title: Aerovia release identity
description: Contract release-identity 1.0.0: frontend/public/release.json, written at build by frontend/scripts/prepare-data.mjs (never committed): the version, the commit and the digests of the catalog and the science document the build carries. frontend/scripts/generate-manifest.mjs copies it into the static manifest (aerovia.static-release/v1); the live check reads it back from the deployed site.
